answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports sustainable qualified revenue because it reports qualified revenue gains and no measurable retention harm. Memory 44 connects the intervention to enterprise conversion and pipeline quality, though it omits realized revenue and durability. Memories 31 and 86 show activation, completion, time-to-value, or adoption gains—useful leading indicators, but without direct qualified-revenue evidence; memory 31 at least notes durability. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift, but omits margin, retention, customer quality, and whether promotional pricing is sustainable. Memory 91 is weakest because it establishes only short-term engagement and first-action movement, with no revenue, qualification, retention, or durability evidence.
